    Profile

    Cassius is one of the God Killers. Though she may have a blank expression, she is very curious and has the ability to observe both the past and the future. Those who try to confront her will eventually have to bow down to her overwhelming power.

    Origin: Ragna
    Gender: Female
    Height: 163cm
    Weight: 48kg
    Birthday: Mar 15
    Blood Type: Type O
    Zodiac: Pisces
    Likes: Disentanglement puzzles, round things
    Hobbies: ─
    Illust: しぶ彦
    CV: 佐藤舞
